title: Apply for a candidate surveyor training workshop
summary: Find out how to apply for a preparatory training workshop for candidate surveyors.
intro: To help candidate surveyors prepare for their final exams and registration, the NSW Board of Surveying and Spatial Information (BOSSI) holds a preparatory workshop, usually over a weekend in May.
who_can_apply: Enrolled as a candidate land or mining surveyor in NSW
Paid annual enrolment fee to BOSSI
what_you_need: A credit or debit card to pay the workshop fee

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to apply for the training workshop.

internal_links.text: Apply to be a candidate land or mining surveyor
Apply to sit a land or mining surveyor exam

faqs.q: Who can apply for the training workshop?
faqs.a: You must be enrolled as a candidate land or mining surveyor in NSW and have paid your annual enrolment fee to BOSSI.

faqs.q: When is the preparatory workshop usually held?
faqs.a: The workshop is usually held over a weekend in May.

faqs.q: How do I apply for the training workshop?
faqs.a: Select the 'Apply online' button, select 'Start' on the application screen, and follow the prompts to apply.
